summary: Dan Lahav, Co-Founder & CEO, Irregular and Joëlle Pineau, Chief AI Officer, Cohere, discuss emerging AI risks, credible guardrails and accountability as frontier models advance with Bloomberg’s Parmy Olson at Bloomberg Tech 2026 in London. (Source: Bloomberg)
